body: Dropped the PROCESS_VERSION edit: upstream AGENTS.md (PV 76) has the merging session bump it. The PR body now says `Process change: yes`. The only change since the reviewed head is that one file, restored to main's value (MECHANICAL).

Needs changes before merge.

The code checks passed. The required UI evidence is missing.

What looks good:

- The command, project loader, and tool library reader use `tool_body::build_library` to resolve the reference.
- The tests compare every library entry with its old drawn copy. They cover both lengths, assumed holders, saved files, bands, facets, and stamps.
- The older-file test keeps the fixture collision results unchanged. Undo restores the reference after an outline edit.
- The process correction is complete. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. Its body contains `Process change: yes`.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, golden file, or snapshot PNG changed.

Local results:

I trial-merged head `822c4c9a610d770afd0eff328af1d3c2814cc720` with upstream main `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`. The merge was clean. All commands ran locally on Linux. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Plan read; this command did not run tests |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-tools --lib` | 87 passed |
| Selected app suites, compiled with `--no-run`, then run with `cargo test` | 215 passed |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 862 passed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The app suites were `commands_undo`, `holder_library`, `holder_reference`, `machine_default_holder`, `mcp_edit_tool`, `mcp_holder`, `project_roundtrip`, `sim_tool_body`, `tool_after_state`, `tool_body`, `tool_body_judged`, `tool_body_view`, `tool_library`, `tool_library_holders`, `turning_holder`, and `vendor_tool_body`.

Safety checks:

This is a safety-tier review because the resolved holder supplies geometry to collision checks and simulation. I ran the PR's six input mutations in `holder_reference::an_unknown_entry_refuses_the_file_by_name_and_never_lands_another_holder`:

- Unknown entry `BT35 ER20`: refused in both file formats.
- Grouped entry `BT30 Weldon`: refused in both file formats.
- Gauge length 5 mm: refused in both file formats.
- Projection 5 mm, into the flutes: refused in both file formats.
- Both `holder` and `body`: refused in both file formats.
- Unknown reference key `nut_d`: refused in both file formats.

The valid-reference round trips and the collision equivalence tests passed. These were input mutations, not source mutation tests. I did not edit the code. There are no changed goldens to check line by line.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:264` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs:85`: add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the holder size controls and the Profile tab with its library selection. The body currently has no screenshot links. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not add images or review evidence to this PR branch.

Notes:

- The PR states that it is stacked on #2054. Merge that parent first.
- I did not run the full gate selection, release tests, ignored pixel snapshots, or tests on Windows or macOS.
- The older-file fixtures are rewritten files from this build. They are not files saved by a released v0.21.0 build.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Ready for the maintainer to merge, after parent PR #2054.

This review clears my earlier screenshot request on this head. The later evidence comment permits this review of the same head.

What looks good:

- All four screenshot links in the PR body load as PNG images. I inspected each image.
- The controls show the change from editable holder sizes to the library sizes and entry name.
- The Profile images show the library entry, gauge length, projection, and selected picker item after the change.
- The body states the capture method. The before images use older UI source with the current backend. This limit is explicit.
- The image commit contains only PNG images and a README. No screenshot or review evidence is added to this PR branch.
- The process correction remains complete. The body contains `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The command and file readers resolve the reference through `tool_body::build_library`. The tests keep the collision bands, facets, stamps, and older-file results unchanged.

Local results:

I trial-merged this head with upstream main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`. The merge was clean. All commands ran locally on Linux, in `.claude/worktrees/review-2092`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Plan read; no tests run by this command |
| App `holder_reference`, compiled with `--no-run`, then run | 7 passed |
| Other selected app suites | 208 passed |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-tools --lib` | 87 passed |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 896 passed, 6 ignored |
| Clippy on tools, app, and UI, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Failed on an existing upstream unused constant |
| Same Clippy command with `-A dead_code` after `-D warnings` | Passed |

The other app suites were `commands_undo`, `holder_library`, `machine_default_holder`, `mcp_edit_tool`, `mcp_holder`, `project_roundtrip`, `sim_tool_body`, `tool_after_state`, `tool_body`, `tool_body_judged`, `tool_body_view`, `tool_library`, `tool_library_holders`, `turning_holder`, and `vendor_tool_body`.

The strict Clippy failure was:

```text
error: constant `MIN_LABEL_PX` is never used
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:115:11
```

That file in the trial merge is identical to current upstream main. Upstream main has no use of the constant outside its declaration and a comment. This is an upstream issue, not a change introduced by this PR. The second run permits dead-code warnings; it does not make the strict run a pass.

Safety checks:

This is a safety-tier review. Holder geometry supplies collision checks and simulation. I ran all six input mutations in `an_unknown_entry_refuses_the_file_by_name_and_never_lands_another_holder` myself:

- Unknown entry `BT35 ER20`: refused.
- Grouped entry `BT30 Weldon`: refused.
- Gauge length 5 mm: refused.
- Projection 5 mm into the flutes: refused.
- Both `holder` and `body`: refused.
- Unknown reference key `nut_d`: refused.

Each invalid input was refused in both the project and tool library formats. Valid-reference round trips and the collision equivalence tests passed. These are input mutations, not source mutation tests. I changed no code. No golden file or snapshot PNG changed, so there are no moved golden lines to check.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The parent PR #2054 is still open. Keep the stated merge order.
- I did not run the full gate selection, release tests, ignored pixel snapshots, or tests on Windows or macOS.
- The older-file fixtures are rewritten files from this build, as the PR body states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
